IC1: Early [OR], intermediate [OR], advanced, [NOT] non metastatic Hepatocellular Carcinoma. Indication for radioembolization validated after pluridisciplinary committee meeting.
IC2: Isolated target on initial imagery (invasive hepatocellular carcinoma excluded)
IC3: WHO (World Health organization) Performance status: 0, 1 or 2
IC4: If cirrhosis, Child A score with total bilirubin less than 30 micromoles per liter
IC5: Creatinine clearance more or equal to 30 mL/min
IC6: Patient informed and consent signature obtained
